first_reader_said: EZR 8:8: Both records are the family head Shephatiah whose descendant Zebadiah ben Michael went up with Ezra, with the same ancestor-of link.

why: Both records identify Shephatiah as the ancestor of Zebadiah son of Michael in Ezra 8:8, and A supplies no distinguishing information. Ezra 2:4 and Nehemiah 7:9 repeat the same ancestral family of 372 returnees; the later return of descendants in Ezra 8:8 fits that family, so B preserves the fuller record.
